content_html:
11 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories

  • NHS asks Rochdale families to help get patients home safely from hospital this winter Rochdale
    Families and friends are being asked to be ready to collect loved ones, prepare their homes and speak to ward teams early as North West NHS services work to get patients home sooner.
  • Rochdale Infirmary dementia care scheme cuts hospital stays by up to eight days Rochdale
    Specialist dementia wards including Rochdale Infirmary’s Oasis Unit are helping patients return home sooner, with average stays reduced by up to eight days.
  • Alan Thomson extradited from Dubai to face organised crime charges in Rochdale Rochdale
    Alan Thomson, 46, has been extradited from Dubai to face charges related to a drug operation in Rochdale and Glasgow.
  • Urgent appeal for missing 16-year-old Michael from Rochdale Middleton
    Greater Manchester Police (GMP) have issued an urgent appeal for information regarding a missing 16-year-old boy named Michael from Rochdale.
  • Cardinal Langley RC High School wins award for commitment to sport Middleton
    Cardinal Langley RC High School in Middleton has been awarded for its dedication to sports and inclusivity in education.
  • Rochdale primary schools launch engineering programme for pupils Rochdale
    Ten primary schools in Rochdale have begun a new engineering initiative to inspire students through hands-on learning and professional interaction.
  • Rochdale entrepreneur recognised at business awards for UK-wide chauffeur directory Rochdale
    John Byrne, founder of Junction 21 Chauffeurs, was a finalist at the Rochdale Business Awards for his innovative chauffeur directory.
  • Willbutts Lane Stand to be renamed the Ian Henderson Stand for 2027/28 season Rochdale
    Rochdale AFC announces the renaming of the Willbutts Lane Stand to honour former player Ian Henderson, effective from the 2027/28 season.
  • Marios Plus Pizzeria rated 1 out of 5 for food hygiene Middleton
    Marios Plus Pizzeria, a takeaway or sandwich shop at 8 Wood Street, Middleton, Manchester, M24 5TF, has been given a food hygiene rating of 1 out of 5, meaning major improvement is necessary, after…
  • Barnet FC previews match against Rochdale Rochdale
    Barnet FC has published a match preview ahead of their upcoming game against Rochdale, scheduled for this weekend. The preview includes insights into team preparations and player conditions.
  • Temporary no waiting restrictions in Middleton for pantomime Middleton
    Middleton will see temporary no waiting restrictions from 30 November to 4 December 2026 along Lance Corporal Joel Halliwell VC Way due to the pantomime.

Weather: Heavy rain 9°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.
